bundle.shortDescription: LLM-augmented chunk-based editor for papers and reports.
bundle.longDescription: NurumayuFacet is a writing app where every document is already a slide deck: it manages documents as paragraph chunks and provides context-aware AI assistance (translate, proofread, diagram generation, and relationship analysis) via OpenRouter.
